crossRefs.note: Yahweh rewarded me according to my righteousness. He rewarded me according to the cleanness of my hands.
Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;
but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,
For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body…
For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.
crossRefs.keyword: in his eye sight. Heb. before his eyes

parallels.note: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

translations.web: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
translations.bsb: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to my cleanness in His sight.
translations.kjv: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight.
translations.asv: Therefore hath Jehovah recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in his eyesight.
